bio.text: David Flippo won the Republican primary for Nevada's 2nd Congressional District and is the Republican candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a financial adviser in Las Vegas and a retired lieutenant colonel in the Air Force, and previously worked for the oil and gas company BP in Alaska.
He had first planned to run in the 4th District and switched to the 2nd after Rep. Mark Amodei announced he would not run.

sources.title: Candidate filing ends with a congressional throng, a smattering of perennials, and a couple Fords
